trials.claim: Plan 1 includes lifetime access to Airbrush - AI Image Generator
trials.claimQuote: Lifetime access to Airbrush - AI Image Generator
trials.reasoning: A buyer review confirms lifetime access is great for images, while the generic terms-reservation and website-availability disclaimers in E1 and E2 do not specifically revoke or limit the lifetime deal.

exhibits.quote: We also reserve the right to amen these terms and conditions and it’s linking policy at any time.
exhibits.argument: The vendor can change the terms at any time, which undermines a promise of lifetime access.

exhibits.quote: We do not ensure that the information on this website is correct, we do not warrant its completeness or accuracy; nor do we promise to ensure that the website remains available or that the material on the website is kept up to date.
exhibits.argument: The vendor does not promise the website will remain available, which contradicts lifetime access.

exhibits.quote: Lifetime is great for use of images! Video is not so great.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms lifetime access is great for use of images.

trials.claim: Plan 1 includes 500 image credits per month
trials.claimQuote:
Stack up to 10 codes
- 500 image credits per month
- Create NFTs, stock photos, illustrations, art styles, portraits, art styles, and more
trials.reasoning: A buyer confirms receiving 500 image credits per month; E3 and E4 discuss credits charged per image, not whether the 500-credit monthly allowance is provided.

exhibits.quote: Apart from a few AI models, in general, it took 2 credits from me per image, which I felt was fair.
exhibits.argument: Each image costs 2 credits, so 500 credits does not equal 500 images per month.

exhibits.quote: just because of the image amounts which is 2 credits mostly per image, with some exceptions of 1 credit, but the models are very lite
exhibits.argument: Most images cost 2 credits each, halving the effective number of images from the 500 credit allowance.

exhibits.quote: I mean, it's $30 for 500 image credits a month, where each image costs about a credit.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms the plan provides 500 image credits a month.

trials.claim: Plan 2 includes 1,000 image credits per month
trials.claimQuote:
Stack up to 10 codes
- 1,000 image credits per month
- Create NFTs, stock photos, illustrations, art styles, portraits, art styles, and more
trials.reasoning: E5 and E6 only show that some images cost multiple credits, and no exhibit confirms or denies that Plan 2 actually provides 1,000 credits per month.

exhibits.quote: but the Dall-E engine requires nine credits (10 for a larger image) which means that I'm not getting anywhere near the number of images per month promised in the offer.
exhibits.argument: High per-image credit costs mean 1,000 credits yields far fewer images than promised.

exhibits.quote: I've tried regenerating photos and end up with similar or worse results and it uses 4 credits every time.
exhibits.argument: Images cost 4 credits each, so 1,000 credits does not produce 1,000 images.

trials.claim: Use AI to create high-quality images and artwork in seconds
trials.claimQuote: Use AI to create high-quality images and artwork in seconds
trials.reasoning: Buyers report toddler-like low-quality images and processing failures, directly conflicting with the promise of high-quality images created in seconds despite the vendor and one positive review.

exhibits.quote: Most of the time you get images that literally resemble a toddler’s drawings .
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports low-quality output resembling toddler drawings, contradicting high-quality claim.

exhibits.quote: The request could not be processed. Please try again.
exhibits.argument: Frequent processing failure contradicts creation of images in seconds.

exhibits.quote: Generate AI art, photorealistic images, anime, 3D renders, game assets, logos, social media graphics, and more in seconds—no design skills needed!
exhibits.argument: Vendor states its AI generates art and images in seconds.

exhibits.quote: I especially like how fast it works and how professional the final images look.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms the tool works fast and produces professional high-quality images.

trials.claim: Plan 1 can create NFTs, stock photos, illustrations, art styles and portraits
trials.claimQuote: Create NFTs, stock photos, illustrations, art styles, portraits, art styles, and more
trials.reasoning: Two buyers report the tool failed to create the requested scenes and produced irrelevant output, materially undercutting the claimed creation capabilities, while E17 only lists generic commercial uses.

exhibits.quote: I wanted a picture of a chaotic contact centre environment and instead I got smiling office workers.
exhibits.argument: The tool failed to create the requested scene, undermining the creation capability claim.

exhibits.quote: and the tool gave me a CHICKEN.in multiple colors, Dall-E uses 8 credits for one small photo.
exhibits.argument: A detailed prompt produced an irrelevant chicken image, contradicting the claimed creation ability.

exhibits.quote: Users can use the AI images for commercial projects, such as illustrations for children’s books, art for newsletters, concept art and characters for games, mood boards for design consulting, graphics for websites, storyboards for movies, and much more.
exhibits.argument: Vendor confirms users can create illustrations, art and graphics for many projects.

trials.claim: Includes dark mode available for all devices, desktops, tablets and mobile
trials.claimQuote: Dark mode (available for all devices, desktops, tablets, and mobile)
trials.reasoning: The vendor states only an Android app is available and that iPhone and iPad apps are still in progress, materially limiting the claim of availability for all devices, desktops, tablets and mobile.

exhibits.quote: Yes, we have an app for Android devices on the Google Play Store.
exhibits.argument: Only an Android app is available, contradicting availability for all devices.

exhibits.quote: We are currently working on an app for Apple iPhone and iPad devices.
exhibits.argument: Apple iPhone and iPad support is still in progress, so not available for all devices.

themes.summary: Many buyers say outputs ignore prompts, look distorted, and are worse than free alternatives.

hits.quote: The tool consistently failed to create images that matched the prompts.
I found the platform incapable of building what I was describing.
I have yet to make a single image that is useful or realistic
and the tool gave me a CHICKEN.in multiple colors
If you want an image with people, faces are disfigured.
For the same prompt, the Stable Diffusion free site (https://stablediffusionweb.com/) is able to generate WAY better results.
Most of the time you get images that literally resemble a toddler’s drawings
I found the image outputs it generated to be unusable when compared to how the ai models would output them natively

themes.summary: Several buyers say the tool creates excellent images quickly with an easy, intuitive interface.

hits.quote: It created some excellent images for me.
The app is very user friendly, and the AI features deliver impressive results
I like how fast it is.
The free credits allowed me to create stunning images in no time.
It is so flexible and useful for image generation.

themes.summary: Several buyers say key features are missing, outdated, or not available in the API and editor.

hits.quote: the API is only good for text to image generation and only uses 3 engines
the founder still didn't make it available for the API
The app still relies on the 1.5 version of Stable Diffusion, which is somewhat outdated
cannot just upload image to touch up
the ability to bulk delete generated images to keep things organized

hits.quote: The request could not be processed. Please try again.
Stable Diffusion never works and has several browser errors.
there was an error processing try again
now you get an error message much often

themes.summary: Several buyers say the deal is a solid bang for the buck with fair per-image credit costs.

hits.quote: This is a bang for the buck.
it's $30 for 500 image credits a month, where each image costs about a credit
it took 2 credits from me per image, which I felt was fair

themes.summary: Several buyers say support is alert, quick, and super helpful.

hits.quote: their support was super helpful.
The customer service is very alert to messages and gets back quickly.
